verdict.rationale: Lindy's own docs let a user point it at any hosted MCP server and gain that server's tools as actions. This lets it add integrations built outside the vendor without waiting for a native one. There is no evidence of a community marketplace, registry, or installable community nodes/components, so the story is only partly covered. Missing for 10: a community integration marketplace or registry, support for installing community nodes/components beyond MCP endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor

citations.quote: Point Lindy at a hosted MCP server and it builds actions from the tools that server publishes.
you can hand Lindy the URL and it gains that product's tools without waiting for a native integration.
